_comment: Storm-creature arc emission (tools/art_pipeline/arc_emission.py). Owner 25 Oct: glow only where natural to the element -- lightning arcs on storm creatures, never seams on fur or hide. Each entry builds an emissiveTexture from the albedo's painted arcs only.

tanglevolt._why: Coordinator 25 Oct (order 4): Tanglevolt's lightning veins are painted into the albedo with no emissive map, so since the 24 Oct Forward+ emission-floor change they light like fur on Medium and High. Stormursa ships a real emissive map and is unaffected.

staticub._why: Coordinator 25 Oct (order 4, 'check every other storm creature'): lightning painted into the albedo with no emissive map (scan of every electric species, close-1024 note).

thundertunnel._why: Coordinator 25 Oct (order 4, 'check every other storm creature'): lightning painted into the albedo with no emissive map (scan of every electric species, close-1024 note).

voltarach._why: Coordinator 25 Oct (order 4, 'check every other storm creature'): lightning painted into the albedo with no emissive map (scan of every electric species, close-1024 note). Its lightning is the gold vein network.
